title: Obex is an Agent whose product is other Agents, industrialising Agent creation for the Sky Ecosystem
content:
A.6.1.1.5.1 defines Obex as "an 'incubator' Agent operationalizing a turnkey solution for the Sky Ecosystem's development and deployment of Prime and Halo Agents," giving "Agent founders a streamlined pathway to establish, build, operationalize, fundraise, and launch new Agents."

The stated goal is explicitly about throughput: "to produce Agents for the Sky Ecosystem at scale, supporting **cohorts** of new Agent founders." The named mechanism is four turnkey service lines — legal, risk, tech, and operational — plus rich content and workstreams.

The structural insight is recursive: Sky's answer to "how do we get more Agents?" is to create an Agent whose mandate is producing Agents. Rather than centralising incubation in Sky's own governance, the capability is packaged as an Agent subject to the same Artifact, Primitive and Invocation machinery as any other — meaning the Agent factory is itself governed by the framework it propagates.

The five named stages — establish, build, operationalize, fundraise, launch — also identify where founders actually get stuck. Three of them (legal, risk, operational) are exactly the fixed costs that make one-off Agent creation expensive. Amortising those costs across cohorts is the whole economic argument for the Agent's existence: without it, each new Agent would have to rediscover the same compliance and risk scaffolding.
description: It supplies founders with content, workstreams and turnkey legal, risk, tech and operational services, so Prime and Halo Agents can be produced in cohorts rather than one at a time.
